tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang gi sdom tshig bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar bzhugs// 'jigs byed dus mtshan mnyam par mnan// srid dang zhi ba'i bdag nyid gtso// he ru ka dpal la phyag 'tshal// 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor du// slob ma dbang bskur bya ba yi// cho ga'i rim pa'i sdom gyi tshig /bla ma'i gsung bzhin bri bar bya// sngon du bsnyen pa'i bya ba dang*// de bzhin dngos gzhi'i bya ba dang*// dkyil 'khor mjug gi bya ba ste// rnam pa gsum gyis bsdus pa yin// phan tshun 'brel brtag bla mar gsol// bsnyen par gsol dang yo byad dri// gnyen po dri dang gnas brtag pa// drug ni bsnyen pa'i sngon 'gro'i chos// bdag dang bum pa'i rnal 'byor dang*// mchod dang sngags kyi bzlas pa dang*// de bzhin bsnyen pa'i tshad dang lngas// bsnyen pa'i dngos gzhi bstan pa yin// spyod dang brtul zhugs rim pa ste// gnyis kyis dngos gzhi'i bya ba bstan// sa chog dang ni sta gon dang*// thig gis bri dang tshon gyis bri// bsgrub dang mchod dang 'jug pa ste// dkyil 'khor spyod pa rnams pa bdun// sa phyogs brtag dang bslang ba dang*// sbyang ba dang ni byin gyis brlab// bsrung zhing yongs su gzung ba ste// rnam pa drug gis sa chog bstan// phyogs dang dbyibs dang kha dog dang*// sa yi mtshan ma de bzhin ltas// rang gi yid kyis brtag pa ste// rnam pa drug gis brtag pa bstan// bslang ba rnam gnyis mngon pa dang*// mi mngon pa las bslang ba'o// lus kyi las dang ting 'dzin gyis// sa dang bgegs kyi skyon gnyis sbyang*// byin gyis brlab pa rnam gsum ste// sngags dang ting 'dzin stang stabs so// bsrung ba rnam gnyis ting 'dzin sngags// gzung ba gnyis yin blo dang ni// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis gzung ba'o// stang stabs tshul ni drug yin te// gom stabs gar stabs 'dug stangs dang*// lag stabs bzhin gyis 'gyur tshul dang*// de bzhin ngag gi 'dren pa'o// sta gon sngon 'gro dngos dang mjug

/rnam pa gsum gyis bsdus pa yin// sngon 'gro yo byad bsags pa dang*// bdag gi rnal 'byor gnyis yin no// dngos kyi bya ba sa dang lha// bum pa slob ma'i las dang bzhi// sa yi lha mo bsgrub pa dang*// mchod dang gtor ma sbyin pa dang*// mkhyen par gsol dang gshegs su gsol// lnga ni sa yi sta gon no// rdo rje phur bus bsrung ba dang*// tshom bu bsgrub dang mchod pa dang*// gtor ma dbul dang snyan gsan dbab// lnga ni lha yi sta gon no// bum par lha bskyed mchod pas mchod// bzlas pas mnyes byas slar yang mchod// ye shes chur ni byin brlab pa// lnga ni bum pa'i sta gon no// bdag bskyed dkyil 'khor tshogs kyis mchod// skabs kyi bya ba shes par bya// maṇ+ḍal dbul dang nges 'byung bskyed// nang gi dbang bskur gsol ba gdab// spro ba bskyed dang byang sems bskyed// bsrung dang mchod dang so shing dor// skyor chu blud dang srung skud bcing*// ku sha sbyin dang chos bshad dang*// rmi lam legs par brtag pa ste// bcu bzhi slob ma'i sta gon no// tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor mchod byas nas// yi ge brgya pas lhag chad bskang*// dkyil 'khor bsdu zhing bdag nyid bsrung*// bzhi ni sta gon mjug gi las// thig tshon byin gyis brlab pa dang*// las kyi thig gis cha dbye dang*// ye shes thig gis byin brlab pa// thig gis bri ba'i chos gsum mo// bla mas dbang ldan rtsig pa bri// de rjes slob mas bri bya zhing*// mtshan pa dgod cing rgyan dgram pa// tshon gyis bri ba'i chos bzhi'o// yo byad bsags dang bdag bskyed bsgom// dkyil 'khor sbyang zhing bsgrub pa dang*// byin brlab mchod dang gtor ma sbyin// rnam pa bdun gyis bsgrub pa bstan// 'jug pa rnam gnyis slob dpon dang*// de bzhin slob ma 'jug pa'o// slob dpon phyag gnyis sbyor ldan pas// dkyil 'khor 'jug cing dbang rnams blang*// bden pa'i stobs brjod gsol ba gdab// lnga yis slob dpon 'jug pa bstan// tshogs kyi mchod pas tshim bya ba// skabs kyi bya ba shes par bya// slob ma 'jug pa gnyis yin te// yol ba'i phyi dang nang du'o// maṇ+ḍal dbul dang bden pa brjod// gdong bcing bsang zhing byin gyis brlab// me tog gtad la 'dod pa dri// byang sems bskyed nas nang du gzhug

/rnam pa dgu yis phyi 'jug bstan// lhar bskyed dpa' bo bskul ba dang*// skyabs su 'gro zhing gsol ba gdab// sbyang zhing nang 'jug dngos gzhi bya// phyag 'tshal dam bsgrags sdom pa gzung*// dam la bzhag cing ye shes dbab// me tog dor nas dkyil 'khor bstan// bcu dang gsum gyis nang 'jug bstan// sbyang ba rnam gsum bgegs dang ni// sdig pa dang ni dri ma'o// zhi dang mnyam dang drag po ste// gsum gyis bgegs kun sbyang bar bya// dam la gzhag pa bzhi yin te// phan yon nyes dmigs gnyis ka dang*// bla ma'i bka' bzhin bsgrub pa'o// gsol gdab dbab cing brtan bya ba// gsum gyis ye shes dbab pa bstan// sngon 'gro dang ni dngos gzhi ste// gnyis kyis brtul zhugs rim pa bstan// yon dbul gsol gdab shes par bya// gsum ni sngon 'gro'i bya ba yin// sngags dang chu dang cod pan dang*// rdo rje dril bu ming dang ni// brtul zhugs slob dpon rjes gnang dang*// dam tshig lung bstan dbugs dbyung ba// bcu gnyis bum pa'i dbang gis bsdus// gsang ba shes rab ye shes te// brtul zhugs rim pa bcu bzhi'o// bzhi pa brjod du med pa yin// maṇ+ḍal dbul dang gsol ba gdab// slob dpon du ni dbang bskur zhing*// bla ma'i bya ba legs bsgo ba// bzhi ni rdo rje slob dpon dbang*// mchod dang sems can don dang ni// chos 'chad phrin las dngos grub ste// rjes su gnang ba rnam pa lnga// sgeg mo phreng ba glu ma gar// bdug spos me tog mar me dri// mchod pa'i rjes su gnang ba brgyad// thur ma me long mda' gzhu ste// sems can don byed rjes gnang gsum// 'khor lo dang ni de bzhin dung*// chos 'chad rjes su gnang ba gnyis// dam tshig sdom pa bstan pa dang*// bsrung ba'i dam tshig bka' gnang ba// gnyis ni dam tshig sbyin pa'o// spyod dang thun mong mi 'da' ba// gnyis ni bka' yi gnang ba'o// gang du gang thob gang sbyangs sogs// brda sprad bum dbang mjug sdud yin// gsang dbang sngon 'gro dngos dang mjug

/yon dbul gsol gdab gdong g.yogs bcing*// sngon du 'gro ba'i chos gsum mo// gsang ba'i rdzas sbyin ting 'dzin bskyed// gnyis ni dngos gzhi'i gdong g.yogs dbye// rtogs pa bskyed pa mjug gi las// shes rab ye shes sngon 'gro dang*// dngos dang mjug gis bsdus pa yin// yon dbul gsol gdab gdong g.yogs bcing*// gsum ni sngon du 'gro ba'i chos// dngos gzhi shes rab gtad pa dang*// mos pa dri dang lan gdab dang*// byin gyis brlab dang snyoms par 'jug /thig le yongs su gzung ba dang*// ye shes nyams su myong bya ba// rnam pa bdun gyis bsdus pa yin// gdong g.yogs phye la rtogs pa bskyed// gnyis ni mjug gi las yin no// bzhi pa sngon 'gro dngos dang mjug /yon dbul gsol gdab gdong g.yogs bcing*// sngon 'gro'i lus kyi 'khrul 'khor dang*// ye shes ngo sprad mnyam 'jog pa// gsum ni dngos gzhi'i gdong dbye dang*// rtogs pa bskyed pa mjug gi las// spyod dang brtul zhugs rim pa ste// dngos gzhi'i bya ba bstan zin to// dkyil 'khor mchod dang dngos grub bslang*// smon lam gdab cing bzod par gsol// gshegs su gsol dang bdag nyid bsrung*// rdul tshon dor nas dga' ston bya// bla ma yon gyis mnyes par bya// dgu ni dkyil 'khor mjug gi las// thams cad rdzogs par bstan zin to// rgyal bas sbas te gsungs pa'i don// spyod pa'i rdo rjes rnam par phye// cho ga'i rim pa rab gsal ba// rnal 'byor dbang phyug grags pas mdzad// de yi don bsdus gzung sla'i phyir// tshigs su bcad par bsdebs pa 'di// 'phags pa'i ming dang ldan pas byas// bdag blo'i nyes gang bzod par gsol// de las dge ba gang bskrun pa// de yis mkha' mnyam sems can rnams// lam mchog 'di la rab zhugs nas// sku gsum dpal 'byor thob par shog /bcu phrag lnga yi rab byed gzhung*// don gsal ba la gzung bde ba// rgya yul mi dbang pho brang du// shing yos dbyu gu'i zla bar sbyar//
// ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
